issues: Site stayed closed all week after the 11/10 fire; the KPI report is titled 'NO SALES RECORD WC 12.10' and its figures are unchanged from the previous week's report, so they are not used.

The landlord has approved the works but insurance sign off is still pending; the insurer needs a fire report from the fire service (£130 paid), which is the biggest risk of delay (Birmingham Project Meeting 16/10).
Raw materials are ordered and on site with more arriving Monday; works will take 4 to 5 days once insurance gives the green light, and workers are on standby (Birmingham Project Meeting 16/10).

Customer bookings for the next two weeks are being cancelled or postponed and booked influencers rescheduled; a provisional online statement was due by Monday saying works would likely start Monday or Tuesday (Birmingham Project Meeting 16/10).
Loss of revenue insurance of up to £500,000 reimburses each day closed (Birmingham Project Meeting 16/10).
Amy said an inspector was due Thursday and staff are being deployed to cover other sites in the region (Birmingham Project Meeting 16/10).

Payment is needed to release the restoration report to the insurers, who then authorise works; the fit out team can start as soon as insurers approve, and the landlord has no grounds to object unless electrical damage is found (Admin Meeting 19/10).
Birmingham managers Jimmy, Valia and Hong are available to cover management gaps at Leicester (England KPI meeting 20/10).
O, who has spare capacity with Birmingham closed, is supporting Southampton this week and next (Admin Meeting 19/10).
Birmingham FOH's approach to driving app downloads during service is being copied in Nottingham (Birmingham Project Meeting 16/10).

Region: a new company wide performance dashboard (trialled at M14) will give week on week, month on month and quarter on quarter comparisons; GMs must resolve their outstanding tasks and post updates on it within a week, and Inka will send the link once Michael's guide video is ready.
Region: staff should proactively offer free frozen ramen to students (ask if they are a student, have their ID and have signed up to the app) to lift frozen ramen exposure and Slerp sign ups.
Region: remaining scratch pot vouchers (500 printed) can still be given out until 22/10, crossing out the 23/10 expiry date with a Sharpie.
Region: all bubble tea cups, lids and straws must be ordered only from Boba Box using the product codes shared on Kobas, with flat lids replacing dome lids at marketing's request.

Region: an extra labour margin of up to 2% is allowed for high redemption sites while £5, £3 and 50% off ramen volumes stay high (Nottingham 23%, Leeds 22%), on condition that service and food quality stay high.
Region: food cost may temporarily run toward 30% for two to three weeks while chefs top up to a new baseline par level for key ingredients set by the executive chef team, to stop out of stock items.
Region: managers can tailor the weekly cleaning checklist to their site layout (deadline extended to Friday) and report the changes at the next KPI meeting.
Region: B2B and PR spend should be tracked by opening a Kobas tab named B2B or PR rather than using discount buttons.
